title: Stone Makes Promises
prose: The surface is not mute. A small sign can describe a body of stone far beneath it.
invitation: Follow what the surface has admitted.
action: Extract material from the deposit family you identified.

title: The World Remembers
prose: A changed place keeps more than its new shape. Returning makes the earlier hand legible again.
invitation: Leave a mark long enough to become history.
action: Leave the traced place, then return to it later.

title: Seasons Turn the Work
prose: The calendar is not decoration. Each turning changes which labor the land will answer.
invitation: Work with the season that arrived.
action: Harvest a crop favored by the current season.

title: A Forest Is Many Lives
prose: A tree can be timber. A forest is succession, shelter, seed, and the lives that arrive between them.
invitation: Return one future to the opening you made.
action: Plant a compatible sapling near the felled tree's stump.

title: Roads Make Neighbours
prose: Distance becomes social only when a route survives repeated feet.
invitation: Let a road finish its sentence.
action: Follow a registered road from wilderness into a settlement.

title: Fire Has a Country
prose: Heat, distance, and life obey another settlement beneath the red ceiling.
invitation: Carry the country back with you.
action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Nether.

title: The Sky Is Another Country
prose: Cloud and island form a geography with its own materials, weather, and distances.
invitation: Bring the high country home in memory.
action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Aether.

title: The Deep Grows Its Own Light
prose: The absence of a sky does not prevent a world from inventing color.
invitation: Return with proof that darkness can grow.
action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Undergarden.

title: Silence Has Teeth
prose: A quiet place can still be actively hostile. Absence may be one of its hunting methods.
invitation: Return before the silence closes.
action: Return to the Overworld after entering the Otherside.

title: Weather Has Momentum
prose: A storm is not a texture on the sky. It arrives, crosses structures, and carries consequences with it.
invitation: Respect the direction of the moving air.
action: Reach shelter and remain protected while the storm continues.

title: The Body Has Weather
prose: Climate continues beneath the skin. Comfort is a condition made between body, clothing, and place.
invitation: Change the small climate you carry.
action: Restore your temperature to the comfort band.

title: Water Must Be Made Safe
prose: Thirst makes every source look simple. The vessel remembers what the eye cannot see.
invitation: Make the source answerable to the body.
action: Purify and drink the unsafe water you collected.

title: Feast Before the Journey
prose: Travel begins before the threshold. A prepared body crosses differently from an empty one.
invitation: Let departure begin at the table.
action: Eat a nutritious meal, then enter another realm within two minutes.

title: Hands Learn by Repair
prose: A tool becomes understood where wear meets attention.
invitation: Answer use with care.
action: Repair the same TConstruct tool that your work damaged.

title: Materials Have Temperaments
prose: Matter does not merely combine. Heat and proportion decide which character survives the meeting.
invitation: Let two fluids negotiate a third nature.
action: Cast a real alloy made in your smeltery.

title: Motion Becomes Industry
prose: Rotation becomes infrastructure when effort crosses a machine instead of ending at the hand.
invitation: Finish the motion you began yourself.
action: Complete a Create process using manual crank power.

title: Rivers Can Turn Work
prose: A current becomes labor when a wheel gives it somewhere to go.
invitation: Give moving water a useful consequence.
action: Complete a process powered by renewable water rotation.

title: Precision Has a Rhythm
prose: Exactness is not stillness. It is repetition arriving in the correct order.
invitation: Keep the sequence intact.
action: Finish a Precision Mechanism successfully.

title: Heat Must Go Somewhere
prose: Every useful temperature is also a debt owed to somewhere else.
invitation: Give excess heat a destination.
action: Transfer process heat into a registered sink until the system is safe.

title: Pressure Changes Matter
prose: Containment allows force to become a recipe instead of an accident.
invitation: Hold the boundary while matter changes.
action: Complete a pressure process without rupture.

title: Chemistry Remembers Sequence
prose: The same substance can become waste or concentrate depending on the path taken through it.
invitation: Keep the deposit's sequence legible.
action: Produce concentrate through an approved family-specific separation route.

title: Electricity Is an Agreement
prose: Generation, transmission, and use must all consent to the same instant.
invitation: Close the whole circuit of work.
action: Generate, transmit, and consume power in one working network.

title: Machines Can Remember
prose: Information can survive the hand that entered it and return as matter or instruction.
invitation: Ask a machine to retain an intention.
action: Complete an AE2 patterned autocraft or restore an OC2 file after reboot.

title: Rails Turn Distance into Machinery
prose: A route becomes a machine when departure can reliably imply arrival.
invitation: Let the timetable move you.
action: Ride a scheduled train between two player-built stations at least 128 blocks apart.

title: A Vessel Can Become a Place
prose: Structure becomes location when it carries tools, shelter, and intention across the map.
invitation: Move the place without abandoning it.
action: Pilot your assembled vessel at least 128 blocks and make landfall.

title: Leave the Atmosphere
prose: A machine becomes a boundary-crossing argument when the sky stops containing it.
invitation: Ask the finished vehicle for altitude.
action: Reach orbit in the launch-ready rocket you assembled.

title: A Life Becomes Capable
prose: A body can grow in directions that remain choices until they are lived.
invitation: Choose one capacity to become real.
action: Spend an unallocated Life aspect point.

title: Blood Can Become Infrastructure
prose: Life offered to a structure can persist there as capacity, debt, and future work.
invitation: Let sacrifice finish as construction.
action: Produce an altar result using life essence you contributed.

title: The Dead Leave Work Behind
prose: Death can leave more than absence. Some traditions treat its remainder as labor waiting for form.
invitation: Give a remnant a deliberate task.
action: Spend a soul resource in a successful Malum or Goety operation.

title: Spirits Honour Contracts
prose: Elsewhere does not answer freely. It recognizes form, offering, boundary, and obligation.
invitation: Complete the terms that opened the way.
action: Finish an Occultism spirit task or a Hexerei covenant.

title: Reality Has Grammar
prose: A spell is not a force but a sentence whose order decides what the world understands.
invitation: Write a sentence the world can perform.
action: Cast your authored spell and produce a non-cosmetic effect.

title: Elements Change the Sentence
prose: Element is not decoration added to grammar. It changes what the same words are permitted to mean.
invitation: Let an element alter the result.
action: Trigger an elemental interaction from your modified spell.

title: Doors Borrow Other Worlds
prose: A passage may owe its destination to a place that neither endpoint contains.
invitation: Return by the borrowed route.
action: Come back through the Dimensional Font after your voyage.

title: Power Needs an Anchor
prose: An influence that persists without its operator must be fastened to place and supplied with a reason to remain.
invitation: Leave the anchor working behind you.
action: Power an arcane chunk anchor and leave its normal simulation range.

title: Traditions Can Cross
prose: Separate explanations of power can still discover a shared piece of machinery.
invitation: Make one tradition answer another.
action: Complete an Ars Creo or Ars Energistique cross-system operation.

title: Relics Remember Their Wearers
prose: Repeated use makes an object feel less possessed than acquainted.
invitation: Let the same relic answer twice.
action: Trigger the same physical relic in a second qualifying context.

title: Source Can Become Machinery
prose: What begins as magical capacity can cross a converter and become scheduled industrial work.
invitation: Let Source finish as manufacture.
action: Complete a machine process powered through Source conversion.

title: Rules Can Adhere to Matter
prose: An enchantment is a conditional law attached to an object and waiting for its circumstance.
invitation: Give the attached rule its condition.
action: Trigger the actual behavior of an item you enchanted.

title: The Body Can Borrow a State
prose: For a little while, a body may obey a rule that belongs to another creature, element, or place.
invitation: Borrow the condition the hazard demands.
action: Use a matching temporary protection to resolve an environmental hazard.

title: A Life Reaches Its Tether
prose: The body can stop before every consequence of the life inside it has finished.
invitation: Some endings arrive only after the fall.
action: Reach death after becoming downed.

title: Ruins Are Instructions
prose: Failure leaves plans in negative: load-bearing walls, abandoned routes, and objects someone thought worth hiding.
invitation: Carry one surviving fact back outside.
action: Leave the ruin alive with something first acquired inside.

title: Enemies Do Not Share a Cause
prose: Hostility aimed in one direction is not alliance. Different hungers can still be placed in one another's path.
invitation: Stand where two intentions cross.
action: Manoeuvre one hostile faction into damaging another.

title: A Copy Can Outlive the Work
prose: Matter may be temporary while its arrangement remains recoverable elsewhere.
invitation: Preserve the arrangement beyond its blocks.
action: Publish the captured build to the lineage schematic library.

title: An Army Walks Toward You
prose: Organized danger has direction, patience, and an ending that need not resemble victory.
invitation: See the campaign reach its answer.
action: Reach any terminal outcome of the warned campaign.

title: A World Can Be Condensed
prose: A finished world may become an archive, a selection, and a verified beginning somewhere else.
invitation: Let the machine carry its question beyond this world.
action: Begin a verified successor through this World Condenser.
